title: 第21章 掌管电的神
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 季川见温栩栩不停眨眼睛，眼中闪过一丝疑惑和不耐。他眉头微皱：“再来一张。”温栩栩忍着不适继续。但眼睛越来越酸，泪水不受控制地往外涌。她想忍，忍不住；想眨，又怕影响拍摄。一滴眼泪直接滑了下来。“咔。”季川的声音从相机后面传来，带着不悦，“怎么了？”温栩栩抬手擦了擦眼睛，看向灯光师：“这光是不是有点问题？一直往我眼睛上打。”灯光师立刻摆出一副无辜的表情，转头看向季川：“季老师，您来检查一下？我这光绝对按标准调的。”季川走过去，看了一眼灯光设备，又看了看温栩栩的位置，摇了摇头：“参数没问题，角度也对。”灯光师嘴角飞快地闪过一丝笑意，又迅速压下去。没人注意到。他心里清楚得很。每次光只调那么一点点，等温栩栩眼睛开始不舒服，他立刻调回来。除了他和温栩栩，其他人根本看不出异常，只会觉得是温栩栩自已敏感。灯光师抬起头，脸上已经换上一副“被冤枉”的表情：“我说这位模特，你到底行不行啊？不行就别拍了。”他上下打量了温栩栩一眼，语气里带着明晃晃的轻蔑：“听说你是素人，没经验也正常。”“自已紧张就直说，干嘛赖我身上？”季川皱了皱眉，看了温栩栩一眼。她眼眶还红着，睫毛上挂着没擦干净的泪，但脊背挺得笔直，没辩解，也没示弱。季川语气放平了些：“先休息一下。”温栩栩走到休息区，接过助理递来的纸巾，按了按眼睛。眼眶还是酸的，视线有点模糊。她低头看了一眼手机，群里正热闹着——财神爷：【丫头今天不是拍广告赚大钱吗？怎么样了？】嫦娥：【成片记得发给我们看看呀！！】温栩栩盯着屏幕，她打字：【遇到点麻烦。不知道还能不能顺利拍下去。】群里安静了一秒。下一秒，潜水的神仙全被炸了出来。财神爷：【怎么了这是？谁敢拦我们扶贫对象发财？！】电母：【？？？谁敢拦栩栩挣钱？？？】电母：【我还等着栩栩拍完广告给我分享新短剧呢！我等粮等的好苦啊！】雷公：【谁干的坏事，我给他劈道雷清醒清醒！】温栩栩想了想，发了一条语音，声音压得很低：“拍广告呢，但灯光老往我眼睛上打，一直流泪。”“摄影师说灯光没问题，灯光师说我紧张赖他……”她顿了顿，把手机镜头悄悄转向拍摄区，对准那盏灯拍了一张，发到群里：温栩栩：【就这盏灯。不知道怎么回事，每次我一站过去，光就往眼睛上怼。】温栩栩把照片放大，圈出那盏灯的位置。电母：【就这盏是吧？行，等会儿你把手机插上数据线，放在灯架旁边，我来接管这盏灯。】温栩栩一愣：【等等，电母大人，您还能远程控制灯？！】雷公悠悠来了一句：【丫头，你要不要把你电母婶子的名字再读一遍？】温栩栩盯着屏幕上的“电母”两个字，愣了足足三秒。……哦。电母。管电的。灯，是靠电亮的。她居然问“能不能控制灯”？？？温栩栩默默抬手，捂住了自已的脸。温栩栩：【……我傻了，对不起。】群里一片欢乐。月老：【哈哈哈哈哈哈这孩子傻乎乎的。土地公：【没事丫头，我们神仙也经常忘了自已是谁。】财神爷：【理解，凡人嘛，看到电母只想到打雷闪电，没想到电灯泡。】电母：【乖，不怪你。等着，姨这就去给你“修灯”。】雷公：【那灯光师刚才不是说你紧张吗？等会儿光正常了，你直接一条过，看他还有什么话说！】电母：【咱也想看短剧里的打脸！！】温栩栩盯着屏幕，嘴角慢慢扬起来。她站起身，走回拍摄区。温栩栩回到摄影棚，刚推开门，脚步顿了顿。棚里多了不少人。三三两两站着，有的端着咖啡，有的交头接耳，目光若有若无地往她这边飘。最显眼的是，每个人手里都有一杯奶茶或者咖啡。而发饮品的那位，正站在人群中间，笑得明艳大方。正是林念薇。温栩栩挑了挑眉。林念薇显然也看见了她，笑着迎上来，声音温柔得能掐出水：“栩栩，你来了呀～”她挽了挽耳边的碎发，脸上露出贴心关切的表情：“我今天刚好在隔壁棚拍模卡，听说你今天第一次拍广告，就想着过来看看你。”“毕竟咱们好歹是一家人嘛。”林念薇指了指周围那些人：“这些都是在隔壁棚工作的老师，有摄影师、副导演、还有几个品牌方的顾问。”“他们听说封总亲自签了一位素人模特，都特别好奇，非要跟过来看看你的风采。”林念薇笑着和周围的人补了一句：“我妹妹之前没接触过拍摄，今天是第一次进棚，让大家多多包涵～”周围的人都笑着和温栩栩点头致意，眼神却分明在打量。那种“让我看看这新人到底几斤几两”的打量。温栩栩看着林念薇那张温柔无害的脸，心里忽然通了。刻意针对自已的灯光师和现在这些“刚好路过”的业内人士，恐怕都是林念薇提前准备好的吧。原来在这儿等着自已呢。请这么多人来，说是“想看看封总看中的素人”，其实是来看她出丑的吧？第一次进棚、被灯光晃得流泪、拍摄卡壳、摄影师发火骂得狗血淋头……这些画面被这群人看在眼里，明天就能传遍半个行业圈。到时候，谁还敢用她？林念薇端着奶茶，笑盈盈地递到季川面前：“季老师，辛苦了，喝杯奶茶休息一下——”季川连眼皮都没抬一下。“闲杂人等，退到红线以外。敢出声，直接清场。”林念薇脸上的笑僵了一瞬。季川终于抬头，看了她一眼：“听不懂？我说的是，闲、杂、人、等。包括你，和你手里那杯糖水。”周围安静了一秒。林念薇脸上的笑彻底挂不住了，悻悻地收回手，退到角落里坐下，眼神死死盯着温栩栩。季川已经转身，走向灯光设备。他抬手调了几下，又看了看监控器，忽然皱了皱眉：“这光，你确定你调好了？”灯光师心里一紧，面上却稳得很：“季老师，绝对没问题，刚才都检查过的。”季川没说话，又看了一眼设备，最后摆摆手：“行了，开始吧。”
content_en: Ji Chuan saw Wen Xuxu blinking constantly, and a trace of doubt and impatience flashed in his eyes.He frowned slightly: "One more picture." Wen Xuxu endured the discomfort and continued.But my eyes became more and more sore, and tears poured out uncontrollably.She wanted to endure it, but couldn't help it; she wanted to blink, but she was afraid it would affect the shooting.A tear slipped down directly."Ka." Ji Chuan's voice came from behind the camera, with a hint of displeasure, "What's wrong?" Wen Xuxu raised his hand to wipe his eyes and looked at the lighting engineer: "Is there something wrong with the light? It keeps hitting my eyes." The lighting engineer immediately put on an innocent expression and turned to look at Ji Chuan: "Teacher Ji, would you like to check?My light is definitely adjusted according to the standard." Ji Chuan walked over, looked at the lighting equipment, then looked at Wen Xuxu's position, and shook his head: "The parameters are fine, and the angle is right." A smile flashed at the corner of the lighting engineer's mouth, and he quickly suppressed it.No one noticed.He knew it very well.The light was only adjusted a little each time. When Wen Xuxu's eyes began to feel uncomfortable, he immediately adjusted it back.Except for him and Wen Xuxu, others couldn't see anything unusual at all. They only thought that Wen Xuxu was sensitive.The lighting engineer raised his head, with an expression of "being wronged" on his face: "Let me tell you, this model, can you do it? If not, don't shoot." He looked at Wen Xuxu up and down, with clear contempt in his voice: "I heard that you are an amateur, and it is normal to have no experience." "Just say it if you are nervous, why rely on me?" Ji Chuan frowned and glanced at Wen Xuxu.Her eyes were still red, and there were unwiped tears on her eyelashes, but her back was straight and she didn't defend herself or show any weakness.Ji Chuan's tone was calmer: "Take a rest first." Wen Xuxu walked to the rest area, took the tissue from the assistant, and pressed his eyes.My eyes were still sore and my vision was a little blurry.She lowered her head and glanced at her phone. The group was bustling with activity - God of Wealth: [Didn’t I make a lot of money today by filming an advertisement?how's it going?】Chang'e: 【Remember to send the finished film to us!!] Wen Xuxu stared at the screen as she typed: [Encountered some trouble.I don’t know if I can still take the photo successfully.】The group was quiet for a second.The next second, all the diving gods were blown out.The God of Wealth: [What’s wrong with this?Who dares to stop our poverty alleviation targets from getting rich?!】Dian Mother: 【???Who dares to stop Xuxu from making money???】Dian Mu: 【I’m still waiting for Xuxu to share the new short drama with me after filming the commercial!It’s so hard for me to wait for food!】Lei Gong: 【Whoever does bad things, I will give him a thunderbolt to wake him up!] Wen Xuxu thought for a while and sent a voice message in a very low voice: "I was filming an advertisement, but the light kept hitting my eyes and I kept crying." "The photographer said the lighting was fine, but the lighting engineer said I was nervous and blamed him..." She paused, quietly turned the camera of her phone to the shooting area, took a picture of the lamp, and sent it to the group: Wen Xuxu: [This is the lamp.I don’t know what’s going on, but every time I stand there, the light hits my eyes.] Wen Xuxu enlarged the photo and circled the position of the lamp.Mother Dian: [This is the one, right?Okay, you can plug your phone into the data cable later and put it next to the light stand, and I'll take over the light.] Wen Xuxu was stunned: [Wait a minute, Master Dianmu, can you still control the lights remotely?!】Lei Gong leisurely said: 【Girl, do you want to read the name of your lightning mother aunt again?] Wen Xuxu stared at the word "Dian Mother" on the screen and was stunned for three seconds.……oh.Electric mother.In charge of electricity.Lamps are powered by electricity.She actually asked "Can I control the lights?"??Wen Xuxu silently raised his hand and covered his face.Wen Xuxu: [...I was stupid, I'm sorry.】The group was filled with joy.Yue Lao: [Hahahahahaha, this kid is stupid.Earth God: [It’s okay, girl, we gods often forget who we are.】God of Wealth: 【Understand, mortals, when they see the Mother of Lightning, they only think of thunder and lightning, not light bulbs.】Dian Mu: 【Be good, I don’t blame you.Wait, Auntie will "fix the lamp" for you right now.】Lei Gong: 【Didn’t the lighting engineer just say that you were nervous?When the light returns to normal, you can just pass by and see what else he has to say!】Dian Mu: 【We also want to see the slap in the face in the short play!!] Wen Xuxu stared at the screen and slowly raised the corners of his mouth.She stood up and walked back to the shooting area.Wen Xuxu returned to the studio and paused as soon as she opened the door.There were many more people in the shed.They stood in twos and threes, some holding coffee, some whispering to each other, their eyes drifting towards her vaguely.The most conspicuous thing is that everyone has a cup of milk tea or coffee in their hands.The person handing out drinks was standing in the middle of the crowd, smiling brightly and generously.It was Lin Nianwei.Wen Xuxu raised his eyebrows.Lin Nianwei obviously saw her too, and came up to her with a smile, and her voice was so gentle that it could make her cry: "Xuxu, you're here~" She tugged the broken hair around her ears, with a caring and caring expression on her face: "I happened to be shooting mockups in the studio next door today. I heard that it was your first time shooting an advertisement today, so I wanted to come over and see you." "After all, we are a family." Lin Nianwei pointed to the people around her: "These are all working in the studio next door.There are teachers, photographers, deputy directors, and several brand consultants."They heard that Mr. Feng personally signed an amateur model, and they were very curious and insisted on coming to see your style."Lin Nianwei smiled and added to the people around her: "My sister has never been involved in photography before, and today is her first time in the studio, so please bear with me~" Everyone around smiled and nodded to Wen Xuxu, but their eyes were clearly looking at you.The kind of "let me see how much this newbie weighs" kind of look.Wen Xuxu looked at Lin Nianwei's gentle and harmless face, and suddenly felt enlightened.Deliberately targeting his own lighting engineer and the industry insiders who "just happened to be passing by" were probably prepared by Lin Nianwei in advance.It turned out that he was waiting for me here.Inviting so many people here, saying they "want to see the amateur that Mr. Feng likes", are they actually here to see her make a fool of herself, right?Entering the studio for the first time, being shaken to tears by the lights, the shooting being stuck, the photographer getting angry and scolding...these scenes are seen by this group of people, and they will spread to half of the industry tomorrow.Who would dare to use her then?Lin Nianwei held the milk tea and handed it to Ji Chuan with a smile: "Teacher Ji, thank you for your hard work. Let's have a cup of milk tea and take a rest -" Ji Chuan didn't even raise his eyelids."Everyone else is waiting, retreat outside the red line. If you dare to speak out, clear the place directly." The smile on Lin Nianwei's face froze for a moment.Ji Chuan finally raised his head and glanced at her: "Don't you understand? I'm talking about leisure, miscellaneous things, people, etc. Including you and the glass of sugar water in your hand." The area was quiet for a second.Lin Nianwei could no longer hold back the smile on her face. She retracted her hand angrily, retreated to a corner and sat down, staring at Wen Xuxu.Ji Chuan has turned around and walked towards the lighting equipment.He raised his hand to adjust it a few times, then looked at the monitor, and suddenly frowned: "Are you sure you have adjusted this light?" The lighting engineer's heart tightened, but his face was very calm: "Teacher Ji, it's absolutely fine, I just checked it." Ji Chuan said nothing, looked at the equipment again, and finally waved his hand: "Okay, let's get started."
